List groups

A column of items in one frame - plain rows, or links and buttons to choose from - with the current one and the unavailable ones marked by the same attributes the browser reads.

Examples

list-group on a list, list-group-item on each item.

  • Ang Thong Marine Park
  • Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan
  • The Five Islands by kayak
<ul class="list-group">
	<li class="list-group-item">Ang Thong Marine Park</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">Koh Tao and Koh Nang Yuan</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">The Five Islands by kayak</li>
</ul>

Links and buttons

list-group-item-action makes an item a choice. The current one is aria-current - "page" for a link to the page shown, "true" otherwise; one that cannot be chosen is a disabled button, or a link without href and with aria-disabled="true".

All sites lagoon.example angthong.example archive.example 
<nav class="list-group" aria-label="Sites">
	<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#list-group-action" aria-current="page">All sites</a>
	<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#list-group-action">lagoon.example</a>
	<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" href="#list-group-action">angthong.example</a>
	<a class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" aria-disabled="true">archive.example</a>
</nav>
<div class="list-group" role="group" aria-label="Import from">
	<button class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" type="button">A CSV file</button>
	<button class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" type="button">Another site</button>
	<button class="list-group-item list-group-item-action" type="button" disabled>The old catalog</button>
</div>

Flush, numbered, with counts

list-group-flush drops the frame, for a list inside a card; list-group-numbered on an <ol> numbers the items.

  1. Ang Thong Marine Park28
  2. Koh Tao11
  3. The Five Islands3
<div class="card">
	<div class="card-body">
		<ol class="list-group list-group-flush list-group-numbered">
			<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><span class="flex-fill">Ang Thong Marine Park</span><span class="badge">28</span></li>
			<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><span class="flex-fill">Koh Tao</span><span class="badge">11</span></li>
			<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><span class="flex-fill">The Five Islands</span><span class="badge badge-subtle-warning">3</span></li>
		</ol>
	</div>
</div>

Side by side

list-group-horizontal sets the items in a row; with a width prefix, from that width of the region on: md:list-group-horizontal.

  • Transfer
  • Boat
  • Lunch
  • Park fee
<ul class="list-group md:list-group-horizontal">
	<li class="list-group-item">Transfer</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">Boat</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">Lunch</li>
	<li class="list-group-item">Park fee</li>
</ul>

With checks

<div class="list-group" role="group" aria-label="Show on">
	<label class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>lagoon.example</label>
	<label class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><input class="check" type="checkbox" checked>angthong.example</label>
	<label class="list-group-item hstack gap-8"><input class="check" type="checkbox">kohtao.example</label>
</div>

Reordering

A list with data-reorder naming a hidden field moves its items, each with a data-value, by a drag-handle: a button opening the list's menu of moves, whose items carry data-move - up, down, first, last - or the pointer dragging the handle. A move is done at once, the focus back on the handle, and the page's text moved says the new place. Then redz:move fires on the item: a page that saves cancels it and answers with a promise - refused, the move is undone and the page's words are said; left alone, hidden fields beside the list hold the new order for the form.

  • The pier
  • The emerald lake
  • Lunch on the beach
<ul class="list-group" id="list-group-moves-list" aria-label="Stops of the tour" data-reorder="stops[]">
	<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8" data-value="pier"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: The pier"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>The pier</li>
	<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8" data-value="lagoon"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: The emerald lake"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>The emerald lake</li>
	<li class="list-group-item hstack gap-8" data-value="beach"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Lunch on the beach"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>Lunch on the beach</li>
</ul>
<div class="menu" id="list-group-moves-menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Move">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="up"><i class="bi bi-arrow-up" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move up</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="down"><i class="bi bi-arrow-down" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move down</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="first">Move to the top</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="last">Move to the bottom</button>
</div>

A table's rows move the same: data-reorder on the tbody, a data-value on each row and its drag-handle in a cell. The hidden fields and the polite status go after the table.

MoveItemAmount
Cement12,400
Steel bars38,900
Labor21,000
 
<table class="table" aria-label="Lines of the estimate">
	<thead><tr><th scope="col"><span class="visually-hidden">Move</span></th><th scope="col">Item</th><th scope="col" class="text-end">Amount</th></tr></thead>
	<tbody data-reorder="lines[]">
		<tr data-value="cement"><td><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Cement"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td><td>Cement</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">12,400</td></tr>
		<tr data-value="steel"><td><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Steel bars"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td><td>Steel bars</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">38,900</td></tr>
		<tr data-value="labor"><td><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Labor"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button></td><td>Labor</td><td class="text-end tabular-nums">21,000</td></tr>
	</tbody>
</table>

In a grid of more than one column, or a row, the pointer drags in two dimensions: the item under it takes the dragged one before or after it, by the half of it the pointer is in. The menu's moves go earlier and later in the order - give them those words.

Sales
Bookings
Tasks
Weather
<div class="grid cols-2 md:cols-3 gap-12" aria-label="Dashboard cards" role="list" data-reorder="cards[]">
	<div class="card" role="listitem" data-value="sales"><div class="card-body hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-grid-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Sales"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>Sales</div></div>
	<div class="card" role="listitem" data-value="bookings"><div class="card-body hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-grid-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Bookings"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>Bookings</div></div>
	<div class="card span-full md:span-1" role="listitem" data-value="tasks"><div class="card-body hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-grid-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Tasks"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>Tasks</div></div>
	<div class="card" role="listitem" data-value="weather"><div class="card-body hstack gap-8"><button class="btn btn-sm btn-icon btn-text drag-handle" type="button" commandfor="list-group-moves-grid-menu" command="toggle-popover" aria-haspopup="menu" aria-label="Move: Weather"><i class="bi bi-grip-vertical" aria-hidden="true"></i></button>Weather</div></div>
</div>
<div class="menu" id="list-group-moves-grid-menu" popover role="menu" aria-label="Move">
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="up"><i class="bi bi-arrow-left flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move earlier</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="down"><i class="bi bi-arrow-right flip-rtl" aria-hidden="true"></i>Move later</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="first">Move to the start</button>
	<button class="menu-item" type="button" role="menuitem" data-move="last">Move to the end</button>
</div>
document.addEventListener('redz:move', (event) => {
	event.preventDefault();
	const {item, parent, position} = event.detail;
	event.detail.respondWith(fetch('/stops/' + item.dataset.value + '/place', {method: 'POST', body: new URLSearchParams({parent: parent?.dataset.value ?? '', position})})
		.then((answer) => answer.ok || Promise.reject('The stop could not be moved')));
});

list-group-item-action

Keyboard and accessibility

  • Links and buttons keep their own keys: Tab from one to the next, Enter - and Space on a button - to choose. A list of links that moves between pages is a <nav> with its own name.
  • The current item is aria-current, never a class: the screen reader says “current page”, the look follows the attribute.
  • A link that may not be followed has no href: aria-disabled alone would leave it working.

Tokens

From css/components/list-group.css. It declares --redz-list-group-row, --redz-list-group-column on its root, never on rows or items.

It reads the theme's --redz-border, --redz-radius-12, --redz-bg, --redz-space-12, --redz-space-16, --redz-text, --redz-bg-hover, --redz-primary-subtle, --redz-primary, --redz-text-faint, --redz-text-muted.
